name: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 2.8 - New Eridan Sunset
storyline: As the last chapter of Season 2, this version introduces the story in which the mysterious target Ramiel becomes the focus of pursuit for various factions in the Outer Ring. Meanwhile, Promeia, the executioner of Krampus, appears as an intelligence contact, forming a temporary alliance with the upgraded Starlight - Billy, the Proxies, and Cissia to uncover Ramiel's true identity and intentions. As the investigation deepens, the Proxies will encounter an unexpected twist — one that brings both risk and opportunity, potentially transforming into a new power that they can harness in the future.
summary: The new version also introduces a brand-new attribute enemy and a new Vortex combat mechanic: When certain enemies are inflicted with the Wind Attribute Anomaly, applying other Attribute Anomalies will trigger Vortex instead of Disorder, dealing AoE Anomaly damage matching the corresponding element. This adds fresh strategic layers to team building. On new version events, "Marcel Bootopia" lets players control Eous to explore a Bangboo resort island temporarily closed due to an accompanying Hollow, rescuing trapped Bangboos and collecting treasures. Completing the event rewards Proxies with Booltergeist and its Bangboo core. This A-Rank Bangboo can hover in the air and fire lasers in combat, dealing increased damage when specific teammates are present. Other events include the "Ultimate Verdict Trial" where Proxies can fight alongside Promeia, as well as many other activities with their respective Polychrome rewards. The new outfit featuring the classic style of the Hoshimi family, Hoshimi Miyabi: Dignified Blossom, will also be available in the shop after the new version update. As for system optimizations, there will be a new Polychrome Guide feature that helps track limited-time rewards progress. Resource and storage management has also been optimized, with a new auto-delete function introduced.
